observed_problem: Fixed-head candidate 68213aaca4ef6d47cf4c06dfe7ae501e3db78b6d had Worklog and Repair Set authority stating that AUD-039 through AUD-044 were implemented/FIXED_GENERIC, while the higher-precedence Design Authority still labeled the phase POST-COMPLETION RE-AUDIT REPAIR IN PROGRESS and described AUD-039 through AUD-044 as currently under repair/verification. A future session following authority precedence could therefore reconstruct the wrong readiness state even though the implementation tree itself was synchronized.
expected_behavior: Before freezing a final-audit candidate, canonical status documents must agree on whether generic repairs are implemented. Because the final five-point PASS is intentionally recorded outside the candidate tree, candidate-tree status wording should be audit-stable: it may state that repairs are implemented and that exact-head CI/final-audit outcome is external/pending, but it must not claim repairs are still in progress after the Repair Set and Worklog already mark them implemented.
actual_behavior: The Design Authority now uses an audit-stable WU-012 REPAIRS IMPLEMENTED / PRE-AUDIT CANDIDATE status, lists AUD-039 through AUD-045 as FIXED_GENERIC, and explicitly delegates exact-head CI/five-point PASS to PR/Human-review metadata rather than future candidate-tree edits. The former 68213aaca4ef6d47cf4c06dfe7ae501e3db78b6d audit is recorded as invalidated by this finding, so its partial verdicts are not reused as final evidence.
